original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Amazon described a brief interruption limited to AWS Cost Explorer in one of its 39 geographic regions, attributed it to user error involving a misconfigured role, and said compute, storage, database and other services were not affected.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Amazon's account establishes a bounded service interruption and identifies an access-control configuration problem while expressly disputing autonomous-AI causation.
original_clauses.adjudication_note: This is Amazon's attributed account, not an independently established technical postmortem; it does not resolve the competing mechanism account.

original_clauses.source_paraphrase: Amazon said it implemented additional safeguards, including mandatory peer review for production access, and reviewed the event through its Correction of Error process.
original_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The operator described a post-event control and review pathway intended to prevent recurrence and preserve operational learning.
original_clauses.adjudication_note: This clause records the safeguards Amazon said it implemented; it does not independently establish their effectiveness.
